name: anonymous-chat
description: Anonymous real-time chat application using Cloudflare Workers and Pages

scripts.dev: npm run css && npm run bundle && wrangler pages dev public
scripts.build: npm run css && npm run bundle && npm run lint
scripts.deploy: npm run css && npm run bundle && wrangler deploy
scripts.bundle: npx esbuild public/js/chat.js --bundle --outfile=public/js/chat.bundle.js --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 && npx esbuild public/js/admin.js --bundle --outfile=public/js/admin.bundle.js --format=esm --minify --target=es2020
